statement.summary: Corollary 4.5 is frozen in Paper/S04_EnumerationCorollaries.lean as `cor44Statement`, the conjunction of `cor44GeneralStatement` (the prime-n formula, right side `cor44RHS`) and the three special cases `cor44d1/d2/d3Statement`. The citation of [banda2019, Cor. E.20] for d = 2 is checked by `banda2019CorE20Statement` (the 2019 corollary transcribed as stated there). The paper gives no proof; the certificate is `cor44_proved`.
deltas: Hypotheses d ≥ 1, σ ≥ 1 are stated in the corollary (since paper v8; up to v7 they were inherited from the main theorem).
Alphabet `Fin σ`; |S_{p^d}| = `numSS p d σ`; equations in ℤ except d = 1 (ℕ).
[d r]_p = `gaussBinom p d r` (q-Pascal); d − r is ℕ-subtraction, exact for 1 ≤ r ≤ d.
The cited [banda2019, Cor. E.20] is transcribed with σ ≥ 1 (the 2019 paper puts no hypothesis on Σ).

maps.label: Corollary 4.5 = general formula ∧ d = 1 ∧ d = 2 ∧ d = 3
maps.note: One Prop per displayed formula; the corollary is their conjunction.

maps.label: prime n = p
maps.note: n is replaced by a prime p throughout (|S_{p^d}| = `numSS p d σ`); n ≥ 2 is then automatic.

maps.label: d ≥ 1, σ ≥ 1
maps.note: Stated in the corollary since paper v8; up to v7 they were inherited from the main theorem. They are those of Theorem 4.4; d is fixed in the special cases.

maps.label: alphabet Fin σ

tex.text:
a finite alphabet $\Sigma$ with
$\sigma=|\Sigma|\ge2$ (for counting statements, $\sigma=1$ is also allowed)

maps.note: Only |Σ| enters; the alphabet is Fin σ inside `numSS`.

maps.label: |S_{p^d}| = Σ_{r=1}^d (−1)^{r+1} p^{C(r,2)} [d r]_p σ^{p^{d−r}}

lean.text: (numSS p d σ : ℤ) = cor44RHS p d σ

maps.note: Equation in ℤ (the right side is alternating).

maps.label: |S_{p^d}|

lean.text: Nat.card {s : Config n d (Fin σ) // IsShiftSymmetric s}

maps.note: `numSS` is literally the count inside `enumerationStatement`; cast ℕ → ℤ.

maps.label: the alternating sum

lean.text:
∑ r ∈ Icc 1 d,
    (-1 : ℤ) ^ (r + 1) * (p : ℤ) ^ (r.choose 2) * (gaussBinom p d r : ℤ) *
      (σ : ℤ) ^ (p ^ (d - r))

maps.note: `cor44RHS` transcribes the sum term by term.

maps.label: [d r]_p

lean.text: | dd + 1, r + 1 => gaussBinom q dd r + q ^ (r + 1) * gaussBinom q dd (r + 1)

maps.note: q-Pascal definition; fidelity to the paper's product formula is the separately proved P01 Prop.

maps.label: σ^{p^{d−r}}
maps.note: d − r is ℕ-subtraction, exact since r ≤ d on Icc 1 d.

lean.text: (numSS p 2 σ : ℤ) = ((p : ℤ) + 1) * (σ : ℤ) ^ p - (p : ℤ) * σ

maps.label: = [banda2019, Cor. E.20] for d = 2

lean.text: (numSS n 2 σ : ℤ) = (σ : ℤ) ^ n * ((n : ℤ) + 1) - (σ : ℤ) * n

maps.note: The cited 2019 corollary is transcribed as stated there (|Σ|^n (n+1) − |Σ| n, with σ ≥ 1) and proved from the d = 2 case — the citation claim checks out up to commutativity.

maps.label: the same formula is frozen again for Remark 6.2

lean.text: (numSS p d σ : ℤ) = lowerEnvelope p d σ

maps.note: Group 06 freezes the general formula a second time (as the envelope F_d(p,σ)); both copies are proved from `enumeration_proved` + `enumerationRHS_prime`. Not part of cor44Statement.
